hook: Ask how old the A/C is.
lines: Ask how old the A/C is. Before you buy a home in Florida.
An A/C lasts 10 to 15 years. A tank water heater, 8 to 12.
Windows and doors, 15 to 30. Pool equipment, 8 to 15.
None of it is on the listing. A good realtor checks it before you buy.
I'm Anatoliy with Epique Realty. Send me a message.
